head: Tots Weather tells you what to dress your child in today
dek: Tots Weather turns the local forecast into a straight answer: what your child should wear right now for what you're about to do. It was #12 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 6 November and costs $1.99 with in-app purchases, by Opticode.
means: If mornings are a fight about coats, it settles the snowsuit question.
todo: Find Tots Weather in the App Store.
